title: Fix implicit return path in TactusScore runtime-controls test double
description:
## Context
GitHub Code Quality flagged an implicit `None` return in PR #408.

- PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Plexus/pull/408
- File: `plexus/scores/test_tactus_score_runtime_controls.py`
- Target: `test_tactus_score_enrichment_fails_gracefully_on_error` -> `FakeRuntime.execute`

## Goal
Make all control-flow paths explicit in the fake runtime while preserving test behavior.

## Planned change
- Convert mixed explicit/implicit return flow to explicit branches
- Add explicit fallback exception for unexpected context shape
- Run targeted test file

comments.author: derek
comments.text:
Implemented the Code Quality fix in `plexus/scores/test_tactus_score_runtime_controls.py`.

Change made:
- In `test_tactus_score_enrichment_fails_gracefully_on_error`, updated `FakeRuntime.execute` to avoid mixed explicit/implicit returns:
  - `elif 'data' in context:` -> `if 'data' in context:`
  - Added explicit fallback: `raise ValueError(f\"Unexpected runtime context keys: {sorted(context.keys())}\")`

Validation attempt:
- Ran: `pytest -q plexus/scores/test_tactus_score_runtime_controls.py`
- Result: blocked during test collection due to missing dependency `boto3` (`ModuleNotFoundError`).

This resolves the static code-quality concern while keeping existing behavior for expected paths.
